scope: Instruction-format research, not MMIO program-base registers

sources.origin: Public Imagination Technologies patent publication, priority 2007-03-26
sources.use: Factual paraphrase only; no implementation code imported and no patent-practice license inferred
confirmed_publication_facts: An example memory-load instruction contains 24 payload bits, six operation bits and two hazard-counter bits in a 32-bit instruction.
An example wait instruction selects hazard counters; an alternative integrates waiting bits into ordinary instructions.
The disclosed thread cannot terminate while its hazard counters remain nonzero.
sources.rejection_reason: No SGX535 product binding, usable opcode values or operand field specification. An example format must not become the target ISA by assumption.
